checks: compile builds committed people, ages, caregivers, goals and listed facet percentiles; others stay neutral
authored background is a labeled private starting experience of its owner only
interventions become pending controller events for their listed recipients
assumptions report lists every generated number, compiler default and stated assumption
scripted dry run executes the compiled policy, including scheduled conversations and interventions
compiling the same spec is deterministic
saved initial world runs under the compiled policy with a fresh controller
a situation gated by requires_facts never occurs before an intervention sets the fact, and occurs after it
option effects set facts that open later situations and give actor and contact a shared role
authored places, routes, groups, channels, invitations and interviews compile and run; membership facts gate situations
a setting review must cite real spec fields; it returns their values, is repaired or fails, and edits nothing

out-of-vocabulary keys, facet codes and ranges, ids, caregivers, actors, contacts, rates, probabilities, intervention days/recipients, testimony sources, fact keys/values/reachability, effects, conversation participants and size limits are rejected with field names
model drafts must compile; repairs return the previous draft with the field-named error, and fail after two
